statements.statement: A floating pin reliably reads LOW when no button is pressed.
statements.explanation: A floating pin is connected to nothing, so it picks up electrical noise and reads random HIGH/LOW values -- it is not reliably LOW.

statements.statement: Phantom button presses can occur because a floating pin picks up electrical noise from the environment.
statements.explanation: With no defined voltage, a floating pin reads random values from ambient noise, which your code can misinterpret as real button presses.

statements.statement: A pull resistor is needed to hold a pin at a known voltage when the button is open.
statements.explanation: Without a pull resistor, the pin floats when the button is not pressed. A pull resistor ensures the pin stays at a defined HIGH or LOW state.
